definitions.explanation: A state that remains unchanged over time, without fluctuation or variation. Often used in scientific and technical contexts to describe systems or processes in equilibrium.

examples.japanese: {定常|ていじょう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
{定常|ていじょう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{維持|いじ}する→維持する：17311_ijisuru⟧。

⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定常|ていじょう}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{数分|すうふん}→数分：21623_suufun⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: This equipment takes several minutes to enter steady-state operation.

notes:
Composed of {定|てい} (fixed, settled) and {常|じょう} (constant, usual). Used primarily as a modifier (with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ or ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧) to describe unchanging, stable conditions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定常|ていじょう}⟦{状態|じょうたい}→状態：03345_joutai⟧: steady state
- {定常|ていじょう}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧: steady-state operation
- {定常|ていじょう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: steady, constant (adjectival form)
- {定常|ていじょう}{波|は}: standing wave (physics)
- {定常|ていじょう}{流|りゅう}: steady flow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{安定|あんてい}→安定：01703_antei⟧: stable — more common in everyday language, implies being firmly established
- ⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧: constant / fixed — emphasizes a set, unchanging level
- {恒常|こうじょう}: permanent / constant — emphasizes long-lasting, enduring constancy

REGISTER:
Technical and formal. Frequently used in science, engineering, and economics. In everyday speech, ⟦{安定|あんてい}→安定：01703_antei⟧ or ⟦{一定|いってい}→一定：01735_ittei⟧ are more natural.
